# BANK-0502 execution report

Status: DONE

Added channel-owned loan document metadata and checklist endpoints. Only a
storage reference and document type are persisted; raw identity documents are
not accepted or written to core databases. Application ownership is checked by
JWT subject before metadata is added or listed.

Runtime evidence (2026-07-10): an isolated customer token created a draft loan
application, uploaded `ID_CARD` metadata with a sandbox storage reference, and
retrieved one `RECEIVED` document from the subject-scoped checklist endpoint.
The temporary Keycloak user/client and application/document rows were removed
after the test.

# BANK-0602 execution report

Status: REVIEW

Added `scripts/backup/restore-core-drill.ps1`, which restores the Git-ignored
core custom-format archive into a temporary digest-pinned PostgreSQL container,
checks the restored public table count, and always removes the temporary
container. It never mounts or writes the live core data directory.

The channel backup companion scripts now cover the independent `bank_channel`
database: `create-channel-backup.ps1` produced a SHA-256 archive and
`restore-channel-drill.ps1` restored it into a temporary digest-pinned
PostgreSQL target with `public_tables=12`.
